+title: Make the IntegrationTests package build against the work-queue Router events
+---
+## What
+The nested package `IntegrationTests/Package.swift` depends on this package by path, so it resolves the new Router through the first task. Its scenario driver reads the removed turn events:
+- `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolIntegrationTests/Support/ScenarioRunner.swift:540-546`: `case .turnStarted(let start)` reads `start.turnId` and `start.promptId`. Change it to `case .submissionStarted(let start)`, which reads `SubmissionStart.submissionId`, `messageIds` and `cause` (`.message` / `.mail` / `.continuation`). Rename `turnIdentity` (`:234`, `:456`) to `submissionIdentity`. One answer can now have more than one submission, so record each submission, not only the last one.
+- `ScenarioRunner.swift:610` and `:1167`: `.turnEnded(let usage)` becomes `.submissionEnded(let end)` (`end.usage`, `end.finishReason`) for each SDK call. Use `.answered(SessionAnswer)` / `.answerFailed(AnswerFailure)` where the code means the end of the whole reply. Decide which one each call site means, and write the decision in a comment.
+- Fix each other compile error that `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` reports, for example `RespondDrainTests.swift`, `Support/BareSessionScenario.swift` and `Support/ShellBackgroundRunner.swift`.
+
+This task only makes the package build and keeps the meaning of each measurement. Behavior changes (same-model refusal, profiles) are in the next task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` passes with no errors.
+- [ ] No file under `IntegrationTests/` names `turnStarted`, `turnEnded`, `turnId` or `TurnStart`.
+- [ ] The scenario log line prints the submission id and message ids of each submission.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/ScenarioGradingTests.swift`: if `Tests/Support/ScenarioGrading` reads session events, add a model-free test that feeds a `submissionStarted` / `submissionEnded` / `answered` sequence with two submissions for one answer, and checks that the grading counts one answer.
+- [ ] Run `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` and `swift test`. Expected result: both pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write failing tests first, then do the implementation that makes them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
